"""Scratch trial (not committed): generate one project and run its PreToolUse line for a few sessions."""
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path("/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-110-tests")
for suite in ("W2-90", "W1-38", "W1-05", "W1-39"):
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tests" / "acceptance" / suite))

import w2_90_kernel_wiring as wiring  # noqa: E402
import w1_38_hooks_support as hooks_support  # noqa: E402
import w1_05_support as live  # noqa: E402

base = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="w2110-trial-"))
try:
    t0 = time.time()
    project = wiring.generate_project(base, "product")
    print("generated in", round(time.time() - t0, 1), "s")
    out = subprocess.run(["du", "-s", "--inodes", str(project)], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    print("inodes", out.strip())
    out = subprocess.run(["du", "-sh", str(project)], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    print("size", out.strip())
    print("roster?", (project / "governance/project/roster.yaml").exists())
    print(sorted(p.name for p in (project / "governance/project").iterdir()))
    print(sorted(p.name for p in (project / ".tickets").iterdir()) if (project / ".tickets").is_dir() else "no .tickets")
    settings = wiring.load_settings(project)
    print("deny rules", (settings.get("permissions") or {}).get("deny"))
    box = hooks_support.make_session_sandbox(base / "session")
    commands = live.hook_commands(settings, "PreToolUse", "Bash")
    print("PreToolUse lines for Bash:", len(commands))
    for role, ticket, sub, cmd in (("orchestrator", "DAEO-none", None, "pip3 install requests"),
                                   ("engineer", "DAEO-none", None, "pip3 install requests"),
                                   ("orchestrator", None, None, "ls -la"),
                                   ("orchestrator", None, None, "sudo ls /root")):
        t1 = time.time()
        d = live.pre_tool_use(project, settings, box, "Bash", live.bash_input(cmd), role=role, ticket=ticket,
                              subagent=sub)
        print(role, ticket, cmd, "->", d.decision, round(time.time() - t1, 2), "s |", d.detail[:400])
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(base, ignore_errors=True)

discoveries:
- The template ships no `governance/project/roster.yaml`, and nothing in `template/` or `src/` mentions `coordination_ticket`. So a freshly generated product is fail-closed for every install, the CTO's included, until the key is written.
- At this base the template still holds `npm install*` / `pip install*` permission deny rules (W2-105 has not merged). The CTO cases therefore use installs those rules do not match (`pip3 install`, `uv tool install`, `npm i`, curl|sh, `cargo install`), so the hook decides them today and after W2-105.

risks:
- **The not-UTF-8 and unparsable cases are the strictest reading.** They refuse a roster whose key line reads fine alone, which a lenient reader (`errors="replace"`, or a line parser) would fail. It is stated in the README as the fail-closed reading of "cannot be read or parsed".
- **`roster-unreadable` would skip when run as root.**
- **Fixed WBS-id example:** the hardcoded-id cases use `W2-00`; an implementation that fixed some other id is caught by the `key-names-another-ticket` cases.

lessons:
- The Write tool refuses `.gov-runtime/scratch/td/`; the session scratchpad works for scratch scripts.
- One generated product per session plus one copy per configuration keeps a run of 179 hook calls at about 50 s.
